findings.location: Product title links (e.g., 'A Light in the ...') and left sidebar category links (e.g., 'Travel', 'Mystery')
findings.issue: The blue link text color (#2189cf) on the white background and light grey sidebar background has a contrast ratio of approximately 3.75:1, failing the WCAG AA requirement of 4.5:1 for normal-sized text.
findings.user_impact: Users with low vision or those viewing the screen in bright ambient lighting conditions will experience eye strain or fail to easily read the book titles and category navigation links.
findings.recommendation: Update the primary link color to a darker blue shade, such as #1a6d9c, which guarantees a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against both white (#ffffff) and light grey (#f5f5f5) surfaces.

findings.location: Product card title text labels (e.g., 'Sapiens: A Brief History ...', 'Starving Hearts (Triangular Trade ...')
findings.issue: Book titles are prematurely truncated with ellipses to fit a single line, hiding essential name details and creating an inconsistent visual pattern where some titles are fully visible while others are chopped off.
findings.user_impact: Users cannot identify the full name of truncated book titles directly from the gallery page, forcing unnecessary clicks to product detail pages to read simple titles.
findings.recommendation: Remove strict single-line truncation. Allow titles to wrap naturally to a maximum of two lines, and use CSS line-clamping (e.g., '-webkit-line-clamp: 2') to truncate only when titles exceed that threshold.

findings.location: Product grid card vertical elements (prices, stock status, and buttons across horizontal rows)
findings.issue: Because title text lengths vary between one and two lines, the content elements below them (prices and stock status badges) do not align to a uniform horizontal baseline across the row, disrupting the grid's visual rhythm.
findings.user_impact: The irregular vertical alignment of prices and buttons makes it visually fatiguing for users to scan prices and stock statuses consistently from left to right across the product grid.
findings.recommendation: Apply a fixed height to the title container (e.g., height: 40px) or restructure the product cards with a CSS Flexbox layout using 'margin-top: auto' on the price and action container elements to force them to align to identical baselines in every row.
